title: 100 Million Black Holes Are Loose in Our Galaxy

scenes.voiceover: One hundred million black holes are loose in our galaxy, right now.
scenes.visualConcept: instant slam typography over red-black void, shaking numbers
scenes.backgroundPrompt: dark cosmic void with faint red glow, cinematic, ultra dark

scenes.voiceover: And we cannot see a single one of them. Not one.
scenes.mainText: AND WE CAN'T SEE A SINGLE ONE
scenes.visualConcept: pure black disc with thin glowing rim swallowing the frame
scenes.backgroundPrompt: black hole silhouette against dim starfield, minimal, ominous

scenes.voiceover: Black holes are supposed to stay anchored at the hearts of galaxies.
scenes.visualConcept: stable centered composition, confident clean type
scenes.backgroundPrompt: spiral galaxy seen from above, serene, deep blue

scenes.voiceover: But when galaxies collide, black holes get flung out, like stones from a slingshot.
scenes.mainText: GALAXIES COLLIDE. BLACK HOLES GET FLUNG OUT.
scenes.visualConcept: split: stable galaxy vs ejected black hole, energy on the right
scenes.backgroundPrompt: two galaxies colliding, violent light streams, cinematic

scenes.voiceover: Our galaxy alone may hold one hundred million of them, drifting silently between the stars.

stat.label: ROGUE BLACK HOLES IN THE MILKY WAY

scenes.visualConcept: giant count-up number, then quiet line under it
scenes.backgroundPrompt: vast starfield, one subtle dark distortion, lonely

scenes.voiceover: A rogue black hole emits no light. It announces nothing.
scenes.visualConcept: near-empty frame, one line of text, maximum dread
scenes.backgroundPrompt: almost pure black frame with faint distortion ring

scenes.voiceover: We would only notice one entering our solar system when the orbits of planets began to bend.
scenes.mainText: we'd only notice when orbits START TO BEND
scenes.visualConcept: orbit rings visibly warping toward an unseen mass
scenes.backgroundPrompt: solar system diagram warping, scientific but ominous

scenes.voiceover: And by then, it would already be far too late.
scenes.mainText: BY THEN IT'S ALREADY TOO LATE
scenes.visualConcept: red slam text, hard shake, flash in
scenes.backgroundPrompt: red warning glow swallowing a small blue earth

scenes.voiceover: Follow mindwired. The universe is stranger than you think.
scenes.mainText: the universe is STRANGER than you think
scenes.visualConcept: clean confident close, pulsing follow pill
scenes.backgroundPrompt: elegant deep space vista, calm, brand-toned
